author: Hotochin
text: Thats good work with the CP zones DT. I have to say that I can have some difficulty myself with seeing all of them. It can also be tough to catch the moves through them. Have you noticed that sometimes price will engulf into the zone, but not go all the way through it? There are times that I will try and short the source of an engulf into a CP PAZ and price will pass right through the source of that engulf stopping me out.

author: Aaron
text:
Hi H,

Yes I have noticed when price does engulf into the zone, and this is when I would definitely try to short the source to try and catch the move, I guess when price just goes right through your stop, it is just one of them trades which is a loss, nothing much to worry about tho, have you seen the rewards on some of the CP PAZ zones I have posted, this would easily outweigh any losses, most produce over 5:1 RR, you could be right only twice to still pocket some profit

H, please do post some examples here, and we will work on it together...
